verdict.rationale: The README documents a `ZCODE_BUILTIN_PROVIDER_CONFIG_FILE` environment variable that points to a local Provider configuration file, which implies providers can be configured. However, the only models evidenced in ZCode are Z.ai's own GLM family (GLM-5.3-Flash, GLM-5.2), with no proof that non-GLM providers work. The '20+ programming tools' claim is about which tools the plan can be used with, not which models ZCode can use, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented in-session model selection UI, evidence of supported third-party providers (e.g. OpenAI/Anthropic), provider configuration docs, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-provider use.
